Powerful Devotional Tool That Just Need a few Improvements. The Faithe Bible app is a very solid tool for anyone looking to stay consistent with their daily devotions and track their spiritual growth. I really like how it allows you to monitor your progress day by day it helps keep you accountable and intentional with your time with God.

One feature I especially enjoy is the daily AI-generated podcast. It’s a great addition that provides insight and encouragement in an easy, accessible way. The chat feature is also very useful when you have specific questions and want quick, meaningful answers. On top of that, the prayers provided throughout the app are thoughtful and help guide your spiritual time in a structured way.

That said, there are a couple areas that need improvement.

The biggest issue for me is the timer for “time spent with God.” If you leave the app even briefly to read scripture or devotionals elsewhere the timer resets. That’s frustrating because many of us use multiple apps or resources for our study time. Instead of restarting, the timer should continue running in the background once it’s started. Having to keep the app open just to get credit defeats the purpose and feels limiting.

Another area for improvement is the Bible story animations. The quality and concept are great, but they’re simply too short. For example, the story of Moses parting the Red Sea felt rushed at under 15 seconds. Expanding these to even 2 3 minutes would make a huge difference, especially for visual learners or newer believers. There’s real potential here to make these stories more impactful and engaging.

Overall, this is a good app with the potential to be amazing. With a few key improvements, it could easily become one of the best tools available for daily devotion and spiritual growth.
